name: Party Time Bowling
summary:
Party Time Bowling is the night in. Grab up to 8 friends, open a lobby, and pile into the same match. Public rooms, private rooms, and join codes mean the group gets in fast and stays together.

It's always Party Time here. Power-ups are everywhere, and the best ones are the ones you send across the room. Grow a ball, shrink the pins, double a score, drop a banana peel, splat a friend with ketchup, and watch the lane turn into a mess. If somebody wants a clean game, Classic rules shut all of that off.
